map.鸡约 21 天，鸭 28、鹅 31 天不同。同一物种也受孵化温度影响，偏高略短、: Chicken ~21, duck 28, goose 31 days differ. Same species also affected by incubation temperature, slightly shorter if high, longer if low. Use species standard period, with candling judgment.
